rules.name: Warband - Normal Games (with Mercenaries)
rules.description:
All warband rules listed on page 45 of the rulebook for normal warbands can be validated by Battlescribe.
Custom Rule - Allows to include Mercenaries in your normal war band.  Make sure your opponent agrees ( Mercenaries are normally only supported in Campaigns ).

rules.name: DEAD PRESENCE (1)
rules.description: Pick one enemy model wtihin 4" of Blaine. This model must immediately make a Nerve test with a -1 modifier. If the test is failed the model is marked as Activated. Any rules that apply to Nerve tests (e.g. Inspiring) can be used normally. This ability may be used once per Round, when Blaine is activated.

rules.name: Weapon - Skullhunter
rules.description: If this weapon causes a wound with a Melee attack, the target model is also Fatigued.  Skullhunter can be used to make Ranged Attacks with Range 6" and Piercing (1).

rules.name: SPELL SIPHON (2)
rules.description: This model can choose to cast any one spell known by an enemy spellcaster within 9" and LOS. The siphoned spell is cast with its original action length, range, dice and effects. Siphoned spells cannot be boosted.  The enemy model can continue to use the same spell in their own Turn as normal.

rules.name: Gobble
rules.description: When this model achieves a hit with all its dice in a single Melee attack against GRUNT or WARRIOR of height 2 or less, the enemy model is removed from play as a casualty. No armour save is allowed.

rules.name: Fancy Swordplay
rules.description: Melee attacks against this model are made with a -1 modifier to the attackers Me stat.

rules.name: Salamander Legend
rules.description: When taken in a Salamander warband, Firebrand is not considered a Mercenary. She does count as being at Rank 5 to match her legendary status however.

rules.name: RAPID FIRE (2)
rules.description: Use this ability when this model is about to perform a ranged attack, before dice are rolled. The model may shoot twice at two different targets that are within 3” of each other following the normal targeting rules. This cannot be as part of a Group or Fatigue Action.

rules.name: Riposte
rules.description: When this model is the target of a Melee attack and all the attacker’s dice miss, this model may make a Retaliation for free. No Activated or Fatigued counter is placed on this model after a Riposte.

sharedRules.name: Is Also Large
sharedRules.description: Indicates the category has the large category as well

sharedRules.name: SHARP SHOOTER (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model makes a Shoot action with its Bow before any dice are rolled. Any hits are resolved with Piercing (1).

sharedRules.name: No spellcasters
sharedRules.description: Cannot be taken by spellcasters

sharedRules.name: No Large
sharedRules.description: Cannot be taken by Large models

sharedRules.name: No Cavalry
sharedRules.description: Cannot be taken by models with the cavalry special rule

sharedRules.name: SHARP SHOOTER (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model makes a Shoot action with its Bow before any dice are rolled. Any hits are resolved with Piercing (2).

sharedRules.name: SHARP SHOOTER (3)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when this model makes a Shoot action with its Bow before any dice are rolled. Any hits are resolved with Piercing (3).

sharedRules.name: Expert Rider
sharedRules.description: This model can also claim the +1 Melee attack modifier for its cavalry special rule against targets of equal Height, not just those of lower Height.

sharedRules.name: Weapon - Spear
sharedRules.description: Models with spears not Engaged with an enemy model but within 2” of a friendly model that is, grant the Engaged model one bonus die for its Melee attacks. Only 1 bonus die may be given to a model in this way, regardless of the number of spears in range. Models with spears participating in a Group Charge Action to do not have to engage enemy models but must end their move within 2” of a model in the group that is engaged.

sharedRules.name: Items Warning - Stats Modifier
sharedRules.description: Modifies base stats from the warband member - this is NOT done automatically so please verify and adjust manually !

sharedRules.name: Combined Fire
sharedRules.description: When involved in a Group Shoot Action, models of this type add +1 dice to their Ranged Attack roll if one or more other models of the same type in the group fire at the same target.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Bandages
sharedRules.description: A model with this item may discard it during its activation to Roll a die. On a 4+, recover 1 Wound the model has previously suffered.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Lucky Charm
sharedRules.description: Use this item to re-roll any one die for any roll made by this model.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Bodkin Arrow
sharedRules.description: When this item is used, the model gains Piercing (1) or adds +1 to its Piercing value when making a Ranged attack with this ammunition (excluding spells).

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Sheaf of Arrows
sharedRules.description: When this item is used, the model gains a bonus die when making a Ranged attack with this ammunition (excluding spells).

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Heavy Weapon
sharedRules.description: This model gains the Crushing Strength (1) special rule. Notes: Cannot be taken by models that already have the Crushing Strength special rule.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Common Mount
sharedRules.description: The model gains +2 Sp to a maximum of 8, +1 Height and the model’s base size becomes Cav. The model may not use the Fly special rule.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Large Shield
sharedRules.description: The model has the Defender special rule.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Wicked dagger
sharedRules.description: The model has the Sneaky special rule when making a Melee attack with this item.

sharedRules.name: Bounty Hunter
sharedRules.description: Remove all fatigue tokens from this model whenever he kills a a model

sharedRules.name: FRENZY (1)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability to gain 2 bonus dice when this model makes a Melee attack (not a Retaliation). Spend the power before rolling any dice. Cannot be used in conjunction with the normal use of Power to gain a bonus die for a roll.

sharedRules.name: Equipment - Rare Mount
sharedRules.description: The model gains +2 Sp to a maximum of 8, +1 Height, +1 Wound and the model’s base size becomes Cav. The model may not use the Fly special rule.

sharedRules.name: Master Tactician
sharedRules.description: After both sides have finished deployment, you may redeploy up to 2 of your models. If both sides have models with this ability, then they alternate redeployments starting with the side which finished deployment first. The redeployments do not count towards determining who finished first.
